title: Efficacy and Safety of Ecopipam for Tourette Syndrome: An updated GRADE-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis.
design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of existing ecopipam clinical trials; abstract-level assessment.
population: Predominantly pediatric; no adult-specific effect verified.
key_result: Review reports YGTSS-TTS mean difference -3.72 points versus placebo (95% CI -5.45 to -1.99), moderate GRADE certainty. Safety comparisons were nonsignificant, not equivalence tests.
uncertainty: Full text unavailable in this pass; trial/report overlap and pooling choices not independently audited. Adult, diverse-population and uncommon/long-term harm evidence limited.
inference_not_supported: New primary trial, proven safety equivalence, adult-specific efficacy, cure or treatment recommendation.
retrieval_status: PubMed metadata and abstract inspected; DOI opening inaccessible through web tool.
